parameters{
	BatchId as integer (),
	BossDataSource as string (),
	BossInitialCatalog as string (),
	BossPassword as string (),
	BossUserName as string (),
	CriticalEventSeverityID as integer (),
	dtAccLKP as string (),
	EventTypeID as integer (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	GBD_EGR_Accounts as string (),
	GBD_EGR_FLDR as string (),
	GBD_EGR_Outbound as string (),
	GBD_EGR_Template as string (),
	gv_ExcelACLKPFileName as string (),
	gv_ExcelACLKPOutFileName as string (),
	gv_ExcelACLKPTemplate as string (),
	InfoEventSeverityID as integer (),
	ModuleID as integer (),

source(output(
		GROUPNUMBER as string,
		INVOICE as string,
		MEMBERID as string,
		CLIENTNAME as string,
		STREETADDRESS1 as string,
		STREETADDRESS2 as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIPCODE as string,
		DUEAMOUNT as string,
		SYSTEM_CD as string,
		LEGAL_ENTY as string,
		MARKET_SEG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[PR_CreateGBDEGRAcctLkp] @BatchId = 9',
	schemaName: '[AcctLkp]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> AcctLkpFileLineBOSSCSV
AcctLkpFileLineBOSSCSV derive(DC_SYSTEM_CD = toString(SYSTEM_CD),
		DC_STREETADDRESS1 = toString(STREETADDRESS1),
		DC_DUEAMOUNT = toString(DUEAMOUNT),
		DC_CITY = toString(CITY),
		DC_GROUPNUMBER = toString(GROUPNUMBER),
		DC_STATE = toString(STATE),
		DC_MEMBERID = toString(MEMBERID),
		DC_ZIPCODE = toString(ZIPCODE),
		DC_STREETADDRESS2 = toString(STREETADDRESS2),
		DC_CLIENTNAME = toString(CLIENTNAME),
		DC_INVOICE = toString(INVOICE),
		DC_MARKET_SEG = toString(MARKET_SEG),
		DC_LEGAL_ENTY = toString(LEGAL_ENTY)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(DC_INVOICE = DC_INVOICE) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		SYS_ID as string,
		ZIP_CODE as string,
		CLIENT_NAME as string,
		STATE as string,
		DUE_AMOUNT as string,
		MKT_SEG as string,
		GROUP_NUMBER as string,
		INVOICE as string,
		CITY as string,
		LEG_ENT as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		STREET_ADDRESS2 as string,
		STREET_ADDRESS1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SYS_ID = DC_SYSTEM_CD,
		ZIP_CODE = DC_ZIPCODE,
		CLIENT_NAME = DC_CLIENTNAME,
		STATE = DC_STATE,
		DUE_AMOUNT = DC_DUEAMOUNT,
		MKT_SEG = DC_MARKET_SEG,
		GROUP_NUMBER = DC_GROUPNUMBER,
		INVOICE = DC_INVOICE,
		CITY = DC_CITY,
		LEG_ENT = DC_LEGAL_ENTY,
		MEMBER_ID = DC_MEMBERID,
		STREET_ADDRESS2 = DC_STREETADDRESS2,
		STREET_ADDRESS1 = DC_STREETADDRESS1)) ~> FlatFileDestination
